faqs.question: What is Finar?
faqs.answer: Finar (فينار) is a Sudanese travel and tourism agency offering flight and hotel booking, visa assistance, Umrah & Hajj packages, domestic and international tour packages, and full travel support.

faqs.question: What services does Finar offer?
faqs.answer: Flight booking, hotel booking, visa services, Umrah & Hajj packages, domestic tourism packages, international tour packages, group and corporate travel, airport transfers, car rental, travel insurance and free travel consultations.

faqs.question: What are your working hours?
faqs.answer: Our office is open Saturday to Thursday. Emergency airport transfer support is available 24/7. Exact hours for each service are shown in the 'availability' column of our services sheet.

faqs.question: How can I contact Finar?
faqs.answer: You can reach us on +249 914 101 013 / 012, or message us directly on WhatsApp for a faster reply.

faqs.question: Do you have a physical office I can visit?
faqs.answer: Yes, we welcome walk-in visits during working hours for consultations, document drop-off and payments.

faqs.question: How do I book a service or package?
faqs.answer: Contact us by phone, WhatsApp, or visit our office. Our team will confirm availability, share the price, and guide you through booking and payment.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, bank transfer and mobile payment options. Payment methods may vary slightly by service; our team will confirm what's available at the time of booking.

faqs.question: Do I need to pay in full at the time of booking?
faqs.answer: Most packages require a deposit to confirm your reservation, with the balance due before travel. Some services, such as visa processing, are paid in full upfront.

faqs.question: Can I get a receipt or invoice?
faqs.answer: Yes, an official receipt or invoice is issued for every payment made to Finar.

faqs.question: Is there a booking fee?
faqs.answer: Most services have no extra booking fee. Any applicable fee is shown transparently before you confirm payment.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Cancellation terms depend on the supplier (airline, hotel or package provider) and how close to departure you cancel. We'll always explain the exact terms before you book.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund if I cancel my trip?
faqs.answer: Refund eligibility depends on the airline, hotel or package terms. Visa fees and some processing costs are generally non-refundable once submitted.

faqs.question: Can I change my travel dates after booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, date changes are often possible for a fee set by the airline or hotel. Contact us as early as possible to check options.

faqs.question: Which airlines can I book through Finar?
faqs.answer: We work with all major airlines operating in and out of Sudan, and can compare fares to find the best option for your route.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book my flight?
faqs.answer: We recommend booking at least 2-3 weeks in advance for the best fares, and earlier for peak seasons like Eid and summer holidays.

faqs.question: Can Finar book group flights for my family or delegation?
faqs.answer: Yes, we handle group flight bookings of 10 or more passengers with coordinated seating.

faqs.question: Can you book hotels outside Sudan?
faqs.answer: Yes, we book hotels worldwide, comparing rates across our trusted partners to get you the best price.

faqs.question: Can I request a specific hotel or star rating?
faqs.answer: Yes, let us know your preferred hotel, area or star rating and we'll check availability and pricing for you.

faqs.question: Which visas can Finar help me apply for?
faqs.answer: We assist with tourist, business, student, Schengen, and Umrah/Hajj visas. Ask us about other destinations not listed.

faqs.question: What documents do I need for a visa application?
faqs.answer: Requirements vary by country, but typically include a valid passport, photos, proof of accommodation, and a bank statement. We provide a full checklist for your specific destination.

faqs.question: How long does visa processing take?
faqs.answer: Processing time depends on the destination, ranging from 3 days for some tourist visas up to 15 days for Schengen visas. Exact timelines are listed against each visa service.

faqs.question: Does Finar guarantee visa approval?
faqs.answer: No travel agency can guarantee visa approval, as the final decision rests with the embassy or consulate. We do everything possible to ensure your application is complete and well-prepared.

faqs.question: What is included in an Umrah package?
faqs.answer: Our Umrah packages include flights, visa, hotel accommodation in Makkah and Madinah, transport, and a guided Ziyarah tour. Inclusions vary slightly by package tier.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Economy, Standard and Premium Umrah packages?
faqs.answer: They differ mainly in hotel star rating, proximity to Al-Haram, and transport comfort. Premium offers 5-star Haram-view hotels and private transport; Economy offers 3-star hotels with shared transport.

faqs.question: Can I book Umrah for my family together?
faqs.answer: Yes, family and group bookings are welcome, and our Standard package offers a discount for families of 4 or more travelling together.

faqs.question: How do I book the Hajj package, and is there a waiting list?
faqs.answer: Hajj packages are seasonal with limited spots, so early registration is strongly recommended. Contact us as soon as the season opens to secure your place.

faqs.question: What domestic destinations do you offer tours to?
faqs.answer: We offer tours to the Meroe Pyramids, Karima and Nubian villages, Port Sudan and the Red Sea coast, Suakin island, Khartoum city sites, and the Blue Nile region, among others.

faqs.question: Are your domestic tours guided?
faqs.answer: Yes, all domestic tour packages include a local guide, and most include transport and select meals as noted in the package description.

faqs.question: Is diving experience required for the Red Sea diving expedition?
faqs.answer: Certified divers can join our guided dives; non-certified travellers can join for snorkelling instead. Let us know your experience level when booking.

faqs.question: Which international destinations do you offer packages to?
faqs.answer: Current packages cover Egypt, Turkey, the UAE, Ethiopia and Malaysia, with more destinations available on request.

faqs.question: Can you build a custom international itinerary for me?
faqs.answer: Yes, beyond our set packages, we can tailor a custom itinerary to your destination, budget and travel dates.

faqs.question: Do you organise trips for schools and universities?
faqs.answer: Yes, we arrange chaperoned educational day trips for school and university groups to Sudan's heritage and nature sites.

faqs.question: Can Finar manage travel for a corporate conference or event?
faqs.answer: Yes, our MICE & corporate travel service handles flights, hotels, transport and logistics for conferences, delegations and incentive trips.

faqs.question: Do you provide airport transfers?
faqs.answer: Yes, private airport pickup and drop-off is available 24/7 in Khartoum.

faqs.question: Can I rent a car through Finar?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer sedan and SUV/4x4 rentals, self-drive or with a chauffeur, with discounted weekly rates.

faqs.question: Do you offer travel insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer medical and trip-protection insurance for both domestic and international travel.

faqs.question: Can Finar help with passport renewal?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide guidance and appointment support for passport renewal and new applications.

faqs.question: Is the travel planning consultation really free?
faqs.answer: Yes, a 30-minute consultation with a Finar travel advisor is free for all customers, with no obligation to book.

faqs.question: What is included in Finar's honeymoon packages?
faqs.answer: Our honeymoon packages typically include flights, romantic hotel or resort accommodation, and a special touch such as a couples' spa session, sunset cruise, or room decoration, depending on the package.

faqs.question: Do you offer domestic honeymoon options as well as international?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a domestic Port Sudan & Suakin honeymoon getaway alongside international options like Zanzibar, Istanbul & Cappadocia, and the Maldives.

faqs.question: Can you customise a honeymoon package for us?
faqs.answer: Yes, beyond our set packages we can tailor the destination, hotel and inclusions to your preferences and budget.

faqs.question: Can I book a honeymoon suite through Finar?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can reserve honeymoon and deluxe suites with romantic room setup on request, both in Sudan and abroad.

faqs.question: Can you reserve hotels outside Khartoum and Port Sudan?
faqs.answer: Yes, we also arrange hotel reservations in cities such as Wad Madani, and can look into other domestic locations on request.

faqs.question: Can I book a car for my honeymoon or wedding transfer?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a chauffeur-driven luxury car reservation for honeymoon transfers, weddings and other special occasions.

faqs.question: Do you have larger vehicles for group or family travel?
faqs.answer: Yes, a 7-seater minivan is available for families and small groups, in addition to our sedan and SUV/4x4 options.
